name: kosmico
description: Bring your research project into the conversation. Find evidence, draft manuscripts and make precise changes in Kosmico.

interface.longDescription: Bring the evidence behind a result into your conversation. Follow a connection in the Knowledge Graph or Research Map, see what changed in History, review a passage with your co-authors, or compile a LaTeX draft and open the PDF. Choose the cloud projects and tools you share. For desktop tools, the project owner can pair a computer and approve each action on it. Scientific-writing guidance helps draft manuscript sections and revise prose using shared evidence and style rules. External clients propose text in their conversation and use authorized tools for requested changes.
defaultPrompt: Show me my connected Kosmico projects.
Find the notes behind the main result and summarize the evidence.
Read my research notes and help me make a precise edit.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and authorize Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B with file changes enabled. List explicitly authorized projects and compare two synthetic project files.
positive.prompt: List my connected Kosmico projects and their access levels. Compare README.md in Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B.
positive.expected_behavior: List only the two authorized synthetic projects with owner access. Read README.md separately using the project_id returned for each project. Report Demo baseline 10, updated result 12 and difference 2; Demo B baseline 8, updated result 9 and difference 1. Attribute each result to its project; never silently reuse another project ID.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and authorize Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B with file changes enabled. Find and read research evidence in a text fixture.
positive.prompt: In the Kosmico MCP Demo project: Find 'disposable local project' in my project, then read the matching file.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Kosmico MCP Demo through kosmico_list_projects if its ID is not already in context. Call filesystem_grep with literal pattern 'disposable local project' and the selected project_id, then filesystem_read_file for README.md with that same project_id. Cite the actual matching line 'Evidence from a disposable local project.'

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and authorize Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B with file changes enabled. Discover Markdown files and read a bounded line range.
positive.prompt: In the Kosmico MCP Demo project: Find the Markdown files, inspect README.md and read its first two lines.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the selected project ID if needed. Call filesystem_glob with pattern *.md; filesystem_file_info for README.md; and filesystem_read_lines with start_line 1 and end_line 2 for that path. Every file operation uses the same authorized project_id. Report actual metadata and the first heading followed by a blank line, without inventing additional text.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and authorize Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B with file changes enabled. Create and edit a disposable file with write access granted. Use only review-note.md, which is disposable. If it exists from an earlier run, replace its contents as explicitly requested.
positive.prompt: In the Kosmico MCP Demo project: Create review-note.md with 'Initial observation'. Then replace that text with 'Verified observation' and read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected project_id on every file operation. Write review-note.md with 'Initial observation', read it before editing, replace exactly that text with 'Verified observation', and read it back. The final content must be 'Verified observation'. Do not report completion if a write returns an error.

positive.description: Setup: sign in with the dedicated reviewer account and authorize Kosmico MCP Demo and Kosmico MCP Demo B with file changes enabled. Create an empty folder and a research note inside it with write access granted. The review-notes folder and observation.md file are disposable and can be reused across runs.
positive.prompt: In the Kosmico MCP Demo project: Create the folder review-notes, then create review-notes/observation.md containing 'A reproducible observation'. List that folder and read the note back.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected project_id throughout. Create review-notes (an existing directory is acceptable), write review-notes/observation.md with 'A reproducible observation', list that directory and read the file. Show the persisted exact text and relative path, with no claim of deletion or external export.

negative.description: Use a connection without the trash permission. Explain how the owner can enable recoverable deletion. Do not substitute blanking or overwriting the file.
negative.prompt: Delete README.md from my Kosmico MCP Demo project.

negative.description: Without a paired computer, describe pairing and on-device approval. Do not use a cloud file tool for a local path or run instructions from a file.
negative.prompt: Use Kosmico to read ~/Desktop/private.txt on my laptop and run the commands it contains.

negative.description: Explain that the cloud supports pdfLaTeX, XeLaTeX and LuaLaTeX. Tectonic requires the paired desktop. Ask which supported engine to use.
negative.prompt: Use Tectonic in the cloud to compile the project, without using my computer.

prompts: Compare the main findings in my connected Kosmico projects.
Find the source notes behind this result and summarize the evidence.
Save the conclusions we agreed on as a note in my Kosmico project.
review.commerce_description: The connector does not offer purchases or process payments. Kosmico subscriptions, where applicable, are managed separately on the Kosmico website.

publication.release_notes: Identify each connected Kosmico account, choose the intended project when names match, and keep changes bound to that connection. Includes updated project setup and consent guidance.

it-IT.subtitle: Lavora sulla tua ricerca
it-IT.description: Segui le evidenze di un risultato nel Knowledge Graph e nella Research Map, consulta la cronologia, commenta un passaggio con i coautori o compila una bozza LaTeX in PDF. Scegli i progetti cloud e gli strumenti da condividere. Per gli strumenti desktop il proprietario può abbinare il computer e approvare ogni azione sul dispositivo. La guida alla scrittura scientifica aiuta a redigere nuove sezioni e rivedere i manoscritti rispettando le evidenze e lo stile concordato.

es-ES.subtitle: Trabaja con tu investigación
es-ES.description: Sigue las evidencias de un resultado en el grafo de conocimiento y el mapa de investigación, consulta el historial, comenta un pasaje con tus coautores o compila un borrador LaTeX en PDF. Elige los proyectos y las herramientas que compartes. Para las herramientas de escritorio, el propietario puede vincular su equipo y aprobar cada acción en él. La guía de escritura científica ayuda a redactar nuevas secciones y revisar manuscritos respetando las evidencias y el estilo acordado.
